Subject Property Positioning

3 bed / 2 bath entire-home short-term rental. The comp set prioritizes nearby properties with similar bedroom count, bath count, and guest capacity within Wilmington.

Market Read

The broader Wilmington STR market averages 45% occupancy and $270 per night, generating roughly $30,600 in annual revenue per listing — and this property is already priced above market at $281 ADR while earning less than market-average revenue due to its occupancy deficit. The market's average booking lead time of 43 days and 4.4-night average stay are healthy indicators of genuine traveler demand in this area. Closing the gap between this property's current 21.6% occupancy and the market's 45% benchmark is the single biggest lever for revenue growth.

Performance Analytics · Market Occupancy by Month

Seasonal performance patterns

Market occupancy across the calendar year, used to time rate strategy between peak and shoulder windows.

Peak SeasonMay to Aug

Wilmington occupancy peaks during May to Aug, ranging from 46% to 59%. Premium ADR is achievable in this window; protect rate and avoid early-bird discounting that erodes peak revenue.

Shoulder SeasonSep to Apr

Occupancy softens during Sep to Apr, ranging from 33% to 46%. Strategic amenity positioning, longer-stay incentives, and gap-night pricing can lift shoulder-season occupancy meaningfully.
